entities.summary: Mgr. Vinsensius Setiawan Triatmojo, Lic., S.Th. is an Indonesian Roman Catholic bishop. He has been appointed as the bishop of Tanjung Karang on December 17, 2022. He is a diocesan priest from the Roman Catholic Archdiocese of Palembang. He is a head of the commission of liturgy, catechetics, and Bible.
